statements.proposition: This change makes the Docker Compose setup work out of the box and updates the README with a Docker-first quickstart.
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: The README part is observable (app/README.md +172 lines), but whether Compose now works out of the box needs a Docker build and run with services, which was not done and cannot be settled from the diff alone. Compound statement, so not labelled TRUE.

statements.proposition: This change switches the compose.yaml API build context from ./api to ./ so that the COPY deploy/jockey step in the API Dockerfile resolves.
statements.label: TRUE
statements.note: The context change is directly observed. The Dockerfile (unchanged by the PR) has 'COPY deploy/jockey /app/jockey' and 'COPY api/...' paths, which only resolve with app/ as context, and app/deploy/jockey exists at head. The compose dockerfile path was also changed to api/Dockerfile. Actual build was not run, so the 'resolves the error' effect rests on path consistency.
